ii --- Page 6 --- MONGSONGGIPA GOLPONI BAKRANG Bichap - 1 - Toti a-ba tua Bichap - 2 - Totina nomil mipal dina Bichap - 3 - Toti jik kima Bichap -- 4 - Toti jikgipako dilanga Bichap - 5 - Totina jaku rikpila Bichap -- 6 - Totiko mangonna taria Bichap -- 7 - Totiko mangona iv --- Page 7 --- TOTI A·BA TUA Bolma bolpanggrip a'gintri talroke, bring andalgripgrip ro'gotsa matchote, Toti a-tot oanga pante den-bilsianga.

Sal nabaramchipak a-mikkangchaka sal onchokramchi a-biding dongpenga; a-kisang okkruchipak wa'nok wa'gripgrip - uno chiring chong'grimgrim; gitching chiring a-doldep dakao wa-nok wa:chong duule chal-ik baring sateming ta'ma ta'ring bakrime ge-dama. A-ba jatchi nangnango rangre chong'grimsa a:gimikko nikwatachim, uno Toti bo'rang dale gatjok.

Dal-a kambe sokdaldal, bilsok jaksokbadaldal, mikkang salgiramiting gantong changchra chamiting; pante soka ma'ate antangna chengteke, bolma bolpang pe-e wa'nok wa'pang tine, Toti ua bilsian antang a-tot o-chengparachim.

Pante dambeomaba gamna rim'na gong-asan ong inja, jakma minaba ba-ku talaba sawa maiko jenachim. Paba itna nanginja ma-ko ku-dongna onnikja; songo rorimgipaba a-ko cha-rimgipaba, jakmanan kadanga bakunan mikchara.
Unikoa, chasonggrik matgrikba bilko tona bilsokja gamo rim-o sokchakja, pele chakna nangaia wange watna nangaia.
Indakean, songni nomildrangba gittim anodrangba, pante bimang chananga jakma ba-ku silana kadang kadang; sako mikgron miknapne sako jako kolpane gisiktangtango seksekpilachim.

A-chang do-misal bebe, mat kimderong mancha; pante a-tot oeming aksan jamang gamesa bolo borang gatari an'tang aba tuenga, paltang wa-kap salenga. Wa-ma wachong duule ta'ma bijak pal-ikang silchajok, chal-ik baring bangritjang nambajok; te-bidil a'gipsoke dilrajok, abong paksuatgrike dal-chajok.
Salak dinga minginja, mikka wachi kenpilja, ru-at tampi innikja, ra:a waring silesa a-ba ba.ku minesa: misi ga'gong sonagong siljokai!

Jakmatangko nigame ba-kutangko niwate pante ku'si ong'engjok gisik ka'srok dakangjok! --- Page 8 --- Mima gipok gilgipok ku-te rongbokbaengjok; ajatchio rimitchin amo pake ramaja - mini birong sika gin'gending, gikgarengni bitchija!
Sal akong mri mri, balwaba balsri sri, mi bijak mojipjanga jipjang.
Attam saliangana bala balsri nangbana, bo-rang sako tugrange, Toti bangsi sikenga. Sal a-bri pachap chap a-kong janggilditoa bri jagring simbajok.
Uchi bangsi gam-aba bate bate ka'srokjok: Tai to tai 10ro Balwa balsri balroro, Mima birong sikroro.
Tai to tai roro Billik kambe weroro, Wachi ra gatangroro, A-rak kari sokroro, Toti pante sokroro. Balwa balsri balana mi bijak moama Toti bangsi sikana bawang; Toti uko nikeming ka-srokbate sikenga.
A-skochi do-misal tengtang gisikatenga, a'sesamchi do-amik ga-kimkime imbikatenga.
A-se wa'gong gongbatao do.kru jinma ba'gimgim chame jika chanbatao mat kimderongrara peng'pat suat malame an'sengtoka dakenga. Bolma olsi dokaba tipja, Toti bangsi sikaba dipja!

An'tam ka'sri ka-sri bangsi sikap sokana gaantima ringringa ringringa Toti bangsi sikata, unoa, a-kisang nangnangchi jal-ik bar- ing sildamchi bi-sa grapa gita mande ring'ringengaja knasingsangsoa: "Totini, mintini, chameni, Chal-lik stu nangako akkuna, Baring dambe silako am-kuna...
Toti bangsi sikako adi jrip done, bo'rang wa'gong rim-krange, gitdok de-e nachil songe, name knatimengjok.
Bangsi gam-a tipode ku'rangba jripa, pil.sa, bini ka'srokatoa sring ku'sring balbaenga. 'An'tam saliango a'kisangchia sawasa?' bangsi sikako dontonge knatimtaijok.
--- Page 9 --- Bo-rangoni jrip jrip jangke tek kollatchi tekako malone, a-kisangchipak ku'sringko knatime ku'rangko ja-rike Toti aba niejok.
Darangan grichim. Name dake nioa, mri mri, sam minako nikjok.
Chal-lik bistit akdaldal.
Baring pangko nioba akani bistit mikchru. ‘Sawamancha indake ang gitchi gitchi gamako akanga?' ja-kol sam minako namedake niramjok.
A-tinggako ting'gako bilsa chadengkname, mikgron wa-chu niksoka kakket, a'se a'sam niwilwaljok.
Indakoba, bimangkoba nikjajok, ku'rangba grijok. Una a-sejoljol nirame nisrangoba mande he-rurani jakolkoan nikjajok.
Salgipinni saloba, bini bangsi sikapo sike roattaioa, nange nachil songe knatimoara, me-chikni ku-rangsa.
‘Baoni me-chiksa ang atoto, da:oa? Songni nomildrangde dimdam saliachi bo-rango asongchike, gisik jada sike chanchijok.
Uchi pantede ro rosiksakenga; ho-e injok ajongde gisik chanchisokjaenga, una a-kisangchi jom'ange nietaijok.
Unoba darangan gritaichim.

'Da'asalni salode chisam kasi balode songo gro jenema angnan sue kal-ama! Ku-sikkoa knara bimangkoa nikjaenga, mai hongjok angnara?' Be-en an jrim sin jrimsa panteba, gisik srik kensrik dakbajokaia ajonga.
‘Mai bima manchasa, chikgipama cha'gipa?
Nikgijade donjawa man'gijade watjawa ajongba. Salarini salode ambin ambin knapde time nimanchagni.' Samdim ritchakalako bololdim cha-milkalako nie donangjok, biaba.
Salgipinni salode sala pe:gitdiloan bangsi sikrongana seng'gnangkale, a-dap me-gong chong:grimo jakgitdal chapmol ritdimao -- uchi chal-ik baring sildamo - sruk gadoe time rosojok.

Sal a-bri pa.chapo a-kong mri dakango, nomil mikterokroka ano ro-rengbalbala, kanchasru chotchi chotchra pittaksru okste ka'ma mangmango pal-taktak chiring kare pindapa; japing bolgong bokako barang basang wataia; janggilchide bangbang ki-sangte jiljil moenga, janggil chikare dingding ki-sang kongkep nikenga; ka bak botingakode sokme dadilakode kni sasa susu cha-milachi watbrakdape kal-enga. Janggilo tengreng te-rakrak olesa, "Totini, mintini, chameni, chal-lik stu nangako akkuna, baring dambe silako --- Page 10 --- gita gitchakkrong, mikchokpret, joljep nabaengachim.
‘Salba!
Ban nomilsa gannagri nagande chinagri nasre! Nikjumangan nikjokma angna sue kal.jokma!' Toti, mikki akrepe ku-kippilgija nidawakaijok.
'O na-asa, bebe ambigipasa, ang chal-ik baringko akrongenga nanggo!

He-ba he-ba nomila, doba doba anoa, anga nang.kon mikjapsogija ku-ko ku-kipsogija nichaksoenga. Bolmani nomilba ku-sikchia ring-ringa jakchia chal-ik stu tekake baring dambe aktete, timenggipaba dim bilondapari jakgitdoko ket sikaijok.
Jama janggi grijok!
Nomil jagok jabrange gisik jadip changaijok!

Waki ku-ki, waek ku-wek, an'na dildil moari wa tektek dokari: 'Atcho. Atcho watbo.' Uchia pantea wagam chikmijilesa mikkang gitchakpilesa rim-kete kal-enga; indinba bilgrak jakgrak, nomil jak janggian jokjaengjok.
'Indi gita salak wachi chake, ru-at nade gane, gitchi gitchi ang gambranparako aririma?' Ka-a ding-chichadoe mikgron gitchak nitate jakgitdoko rim-ketakosan rim-ketaijok.
"Atcho kema. Watbo.
Ne, angko watbo." Bilchi ka'chian krengede nipara.
"Kemaja damaja. Na-a makna cha'aua watja.
Songchi e'na nanga." Jakgitdoko sikari salrikskaenga.
Uchide grapasik mikoasik ku-eng ku'engsa, Totiko nidoe jaksa ka.baktang rim'penge: “"Kema. Anga akjajoka.
Ne, watbo." Inchi Totiskara, "Watja.

Watja." ku-sikba tipja rim-akoba watja, salakosan salenga. Dingol poksru poksru, gramchi spit spit, me-gong ja'pang bawile chal-ik baring minpile, adi jarokalean uchi nomil jilenga uko pante salenga an-tangtangnade ong'grikaijok.
Indakoba Totini a'tot cha'gipa songonara chel-biade ong.inja, biding ro'rengsasan rongpenga, song skopong nidoa.
Ua bilside
